title: Run Ortigas 2026 Review: What the 2025 Race Was Like
seo_title: Run Ortigas Review: 2025 Course, Weather, 7am Sweep, Results
meta_description: Run Ortigas review from the 2025 race in Pasig: a 16 km and 10 km through Ortigas East, 26°C to 27°C with 89% to 94% humidity, a 7am ambulance sweep and how fast 582 10 km finishers ran.
dek: What RunRio's Ortigas East race was like in November 2025, when its longest distance was 16 km: the streets it used, a muggy Manila morning, the strict 7am sweep and how fast the field ran. The 21 km is new for 2026.
verdict: Enter if you want a short, well-run city race in Pasig with drinks on the course and partly closed roads. In 2025 the longest race was a 16 km, the biggest with 941 results, alongside a 10 km, 5 km and dog run, looping from Tiendesitas through Ortigas East. Manila airport recorded 26°C to 27°C with 89% to 94% humidity through the early morning. The catch is the clock: from 7am an ambulance picks up anyone still on the course, and they are disqualified. The 2026 race adds a 21 km, its first.

sections.heading: The Course: Ortigas East and Pasig's Business District
paragraphs: Run Ortigas is RunRio's race with Ortigas Land through the company's Ortigas East development in Pasig, and 2025 was its fourth year [1]. Every race started beside Tiendesitas on Retail Road [2]. Daily Tribune's report traced a route from the start along Julia Vargas Avenue, Meralco Avenue, St. Paul Street, Lanuza Street and Central Avenue and back to the finish [4]. Runners had to stay inside the barriers and cones, and the courses were measured to RunRio's standard [3].

In 2025 the race offered a 16 km (10 miles), a 10 km, a 5 km and a 1 km run with dogs [5][6]. The 16 km was new: in 2024 the longest race was a 10 km, with a 5 km, 3 km and dog run [7]. Parts of the route were closed to traffic [2].

sections.heading: The Weather: Warm and Muggy
paragraphs: Manila's Ninoy Aquino airport, about 12 km south-west of Ortigas, recorded 27°C with a 25°C dew point and 89% humidity at 3am, 26°C and 94% humidity at 4am and 5am, and 27°C with 84% to 89% humidity at 6am and 7am, with light, variable winds [11]. It was 28°C at 8am and 30°C at 9am [11].
A 25°C dew point is heavy air even before sunrise. Pace for the humidity, use every drinks station, and remember that the 7am sweep leaves little room for a slow second half.

sections.heading: The Sweep, Aid and Rules
paragraphs: Run Ortigas has no generous time limit. Runners who arrived more than 15 minutes after their gun could not start, and from 7am an ambulance picked up runners still on the route so the roads could reopen; those runners were disqualified and taken to the finish [2]. Gun times and course limits were marked to be announced and were not published in the race mechanics [3], so check the race guide for your wave's start.

Hydration stations along the route served water and Gatorade, and there were first-aid stations, route marshals and paramedics on patrol [2]. Containers over a litre were banned, as were unofficial pacers and bandits [3]. Bag-deposit tents, changing areas and portable toilets were in the activity area, and the Tiendesitas ground-floor toilets were open [2].

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: The 10 km had 582 finishers. It was won in 36:20 by a man and 49:22 by a woman; tenth place was 49:31 and tenth woman 1:07:14 [12]. The median finisher took 1:23:48 and the slowest tenth more than 1:45. Only 6% broke an hour, and 47% of finishers were women [12]. Most were in their twenties and thirties [12].

The 10 km shrank and slowed after the 16 km arrived. In 2024, when it was the longest race, it had 928 finishers, a median of 1:18:23 and 13% under an hour; in 2025 finishers fell by 37% and the median slowed by five minutes [12][13]. The drop came in the year the 16 km arrived and drew 941 results; the 5 km had 834 [6]. No prize money was listed.

sections.heading: Entry and What You Got
paragraphs: Fees in 2025 were PHP 1,600 early and PHP 1,800 regular for the 16 km, PHP 1,200 and 1,400 for the 10 km, and PHP 1,000 and 1,200 for the 5 km and dog run [5]. Every runner got a singlet, bib, medal and loot bag; only the 16 km included a finisher shirt [5]. Finishers also got drinks at the finish and a race analysis within three days [2].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a neat, compact city race on partly closed roads with drinks on the course, and you can finish comfortably before 7am.
Think twice about the new 21 km if you are a slow half marathoner: the 7am sweep still applies in 2026 [10], so your finishing time depends on when your gun goes.

The 2026 race is on Sunday 15 November at Ortigas East, with a 21 km for runners aged 18 and over, a 10 km, 5 km and 1 km, and an event time listed as 3am [8][9]. All finishers get a medal, towel and loot bag, and 21 km finishers a finisher shirt [10].
Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on the organiser's race information, a press report, the full results for 2024 and 2025, and airport weather records.

faqs.question: Does Run Ortigas have a 21 km?
faqs.answer: Only from 2026. The 2025 race, on 16 November, offered a 16 km (10 miles), 10 km, 5 km and dog run, and in 2024 the longest race was 10 km. The 15 November 2026 race adds a 21 km for runners aged 18 and over, with a finisher shirt for 21 km finishers.

faqs.question: What happens if you are slow at Run Ortigas?
faqs.answer: From 7am an ambulance picks up runners still on the course so the roads can reopen, and those runners are disqualified. Runners who arrive more than 15 minutes after their gun cannot start. The rule applied in 2025 and is repeated for 2026, so plan to finish before 7am.

faqs.question: How fast is the Run Ortigas 10 km?
faqs.answer: Relaxed. In 2025 the 10 km had 582 finishers with a median of 1:23:48, and only 6% broke an hour. It was won in 36:20 by a man and 49:22 by a woman, and almost half the finishers were women. The 2024 median was 1:18:23.

faqs.question: What is the weather like at Run Ortigas?
faqs.answer: Warm and muggy. On race morning in 2025 Manila airport recorded 26°C to 27°C from 3am to 7am, with a dew point of 24°C to 25°C and humidity up to 94%, and only light wind. It was 28°C by 8am.

editorial_notes: Written 2026-11-06 about the previous edition (Sunday 16 November 2025), for runners deciding on the 2026 race. Our finish-time data holds only the 10 km for 2024 and 2025; the 2025 race's longest and largest race was a 16 km (941 results), whose times are not analysed here, and the 21 km is new in 2026. Result counts per race are from Race Roster's results data. Finish-time figures are Run SEA's analysis of the official Race Roster 10 km results. The 6am time on the 2025 event page is not labelled a gun time and gun times were 'to be announced' in the mechanics, so weather is given for 3am to 7am. Weather is from Manila airport METAR, about 12 km from Ortigas East. Daily Tribune's winning times for the 16 km are internally inconsistent and its 10 km women's time disagrees with the official results, so only its route description is used. No runner blogs or social posts were found. No rating.
